rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for letting food or drinks lose heat before using them.

example.english: The soup is so hot—let it cool before drinking.
example.traditional: 啲湯咁熱，等佢放涼先飲啦。
example.jyutping: di1 tong1 gam3 jit6 dang2 keoi5 fong3 loeng4 sin1 jam2 laa1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for physically cool weather or something that provides heat relief.

example.english: The breeze feels cool today, so it’s much more comfortable to walk outside.
example.traditional: 今日啲風好涼，行出街舒服好多。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 fung1 hou2 loeng4 hang4 ceot1 gaai1 syu1 fuk6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use 型 for a person, look, or thing that is stylish or impressively cool, including the exciting or awesome slice of sense 9.

example.english: Your outfit looks really cool today.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 go3 zou6 jing4 hou2 jing4 wo3

rows.note: Use this when actively lowering the temperature of something, rather than simply leaving it to cool.

example.english: Turning on the air conditioner can cool down the room.
example.traditional: 開冷氣可以幫間房降溫。
example.jyutping: hoi1 laang5 hei3 ho2 ji5 bong1 gaan1 fong2 gong3 wan1

rows.note: Use 冇問題 when something is acceptable, when you are fine with it, or when a relationship has no hard feelings.

example.english: Changing the time? No problem; I’m cool with it.
example.traditional: 改時間？冇問題，我冇所謂。
example.jyutping: goi2 si4 gaan3 mou5 man6 tai4 ngo5 mou5 so2 wai6

rows.note: Use 冷靜 when telling someone to stay calm and keep control of their emotions.

example.english: Stay cool and tell me slowly.
example.jyutping: laang5 zing6 di1 maan6 maan6 gong2

rows.note: Use this mainly for a relationship, conflict, or passion becoming less warm or intense; it is more common in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The relationship between the two countries is beginning to cool.
example.jyutping: loeng5 gwok3 gwaan1 hai6 hoi1 ci2 laang5 koek3

rows.note: Use this everyday construction to make a feeling, conflict, or other state less intense, as in making A less B.

example.english: Taking a break can make everyone cool down a bit.
example.traditional: 休息一陣可以令大家冇咁燥。
example.jyutping: jau1 sik1 jat1 zan6 ho2 ji5 ling6 daai6 gaa1 mou5 gam3 cou3
